name: @red-cup-engineering/fastmail-services-section
description: The Group's mail at Fastmail through JMAP: opens a session on an API token kept private on the node, makes an address ready to send (an identity, and the alias behind it, with the person at the node doing what Fastmail keeps for a person), sends plain-text messages idempotently by Message-ID, and lists and reads what reached a given set of addresses.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs test/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
